{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Dag. I ride with the Bowl Farmers, the patrol that keeps the roads near these walls. Keep your guns cold inside the gate and we'll get along fine.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is the road like?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who pays the Farmers?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who are the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_road"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you mean, pay the raiders?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_kiln"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do tenants serve with you?","/str",{"VAR?":"dag_pay"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you know where that Army wagon is?","/str","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},{"VAR?":"dag_wagon"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Nobody raided that wagon.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^What did the well house make of it?","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^told","/str","==","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Dusty, and worse every season. A truck that breaks down out there waits a long time for a friendly face, so carry water and a spare belt, and don't wander off the track.","
","^Raiders sniff around the roads too. It's nothing we can't run off, but you'll want your gun ready.","
","^The Army at <term=nose>Nose</term> watches the stretch in front of its own gate, and it does that well enough.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_road","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
",["ev",{"x()":"board_full"},"/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You're carrying enough promises already. Finish a few and then ask me again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!",{"x()":"has_offers"},"&&","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^There's nothing on the board you could take right now. Make some room on your truck and ask again.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],["ev",{"x()":"has_work"},"!","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^The board's empty today. Come back in a couple of days, it fills slowly.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},{"->":".^.^.^.4"},null]}],"nop","
","^I might have a haul for you, if you want it. ","#","^work_offer","/#","
",["ev","str","^I will take it.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not now.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",{"x()":"take_work"},"pop","/ev","
","^Good. Bowl remembers the people who deliver, so don't make me regret this.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-2":["
","^Not enough people, to be plain. The <term=granary>Granary</term> pays out of its count of sacks, the long convoys pay a fee, and the tenants put in a share of their harvest.","
","^Nose pays nothing, because it guards only its own walls. So each town watches the road by its own gate and nobody watches between the towns. I don't like it, and I don't know a cure.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_pay","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^There's a pair of camps. Kiln Camp sits out east, south of the big crater, and <term=scrapjaw>Scrapjaw Camp</term> is far up north. Most days they'd rather rob you than kill you, because a dead driver hauls nothing next week.","
","^So pay them or outrun them, but don't fire the first shot if you want to grow old.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^The Army's all right on the road. Off it, they act as though the basin belongs to them and the rest of us are only borrowing it. Bowl was feeding people long before Nose put up its first fence.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The Granary pays Kiln Camp a sack of grain for every armed truck that crosses their road. It costs less than a funeral.","
","^If they close on you anyway, fight hard. They often let a hard fighter go, and they strip a soft one down to the frame. Don't start the fight. But once they start it, don't hold back.","
","ev","str","^talkKilnFight","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Some do. They're good drivers, but they've got no vote, so they ride in our coats without being on the roll of citizens. The <term=senate>Senate</term> wants them on the road and off the roll.","
","^Jory Baptiste keeps sending more of them, and I can't decide whether to thank him or watch him.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^I do. She's in a hollow below the bend in our north road, below where the <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term> track branches off. North-east of here. I rode down to her myself.","
","^Rule first: take nothing from that hollow up to Nose. The reason is that Nose blames the first driver it finds near its guns, and then it sends trucks down my road to ask questions.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"dag_wagon","re":true},"ev","str","^wagonDag","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^No. I walked that hollow too. Not one casing in the grit, and not a hole in her. Whatever stove in that cab came from her own bed.","
","^Nose says raiders, and every driver who buys water here believes it. If you want it said, say it at the well house where they all drink. I'll stand next to you while you do.","
",["ev","str","^Say it at the well house.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Not yet.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev","str","^told","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^You say it at Hattie's, plainly, to whoever is holding a cup: no brass, no holes, the cab pushed in from the bed. Dag stands next to you and says he counted the same. ","#","^page","/#","
","^A woman at the cistern puts her bucket down. Her son was the gunner on that wagon, she says. Nobody had told her it was his own gun.","
","^A pair of Nose soldiers buying water hear every word. They fill their drums and leave without talking to each other.","
",{"->":"start.hub"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.hub"},null]}],null],"c-9":["
","^Bowl talks over its cups, and Nose soldiers drink from the same well. Now they ask the Farmers whose pins hold. I don't mind that question.","
","^I still want Nose trucks off my road. Before, they'd have come down asking who stripped their wagon. Now they'd come asking who told.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_road"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_kiln"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_pay"},false,{"VAR=":"dag_wagon"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_hattie.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Water costs here, talk doesn't, and I hear everything that happens in <term=bowl>Bowl</term> twice. Once when it happens, and once when somebody's improved it.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Tell me about the tow man.","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"VAR?":"hattie_tow"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why would he want a Varga?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_tow"},{"VAR?":"hattie_varga"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^I found my truck at that farm.","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_varga"},{"VAR?":"hattie_farm"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who stripped my truck?","/str",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},{"VAR?":"hattie_strip"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Heard any rumors?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_rumor"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Any local legends?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who comes through here?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Who asks about the Granary?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_granary"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the soldiers from Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_strangers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Will the Nose soldiers stop me on the road?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_soldiers"},{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^What if I go up to Nose unarmed?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_roads"},{"VAR?":"hattie_unarmed"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^What about the glass at the Glass Flats?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_flats"},{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the Sunward do with strangers?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_glass"},{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":5},"ev","str","^Have you seen one come out?","/str",{"VAR?":"hattie_sunward"},{"VAR?":"hattie_came_out"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-13","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-14","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Big and slow-spoken, with a <term=pierce>Pierce</term> coat gone white at the seams. That tag on his chain is an old Pierce yard tag. Before the crews took the yard, Pierce hung one on every key and chain it owned.","
","^If your key has a brass tag, it came from the same yard.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_tow","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Ask Ruth, not me. The Vargas had a farm down at the foot of the rim, with a water tower over it, until their well went dry. She came up to the terraces with her name and not much else.","
","^He didn't stay to see her, mind. A man with good news waits for an answer.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_varga","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Hattie puts the bucket down.","
","^Then that's Danil Varga's pickup you're driving. Her boy. He went west with a convoy and never came back, and she left the farm the year after.","
","^The whole well house will know it by noon, so you'd best see Ruth before she hears it from somebody else.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_farm","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Not the tow man. It came in on his chain like that, with the bed bare and the engine open. Whoever did it took their time and left you breathing, and out on the open road that counts as manners.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strip","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^A scavenger came through a few days back, trying to sell a <term=nose>Nose</term> Army radio. He swore he'd pulled it off an Army wagon sitting dead in the hills north-east of here.","
","^When the patrol asked him where exactly, he filled his tank and left by the west road before dark.","
","ev","str","^wagonBowl","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^You know the <term=glass_flats>Glass Flats</term>, out east, where the ground melted into glass? There's supposed to be an Old World tank out there that still runs. It rolls out at night with its lights off.","
","^My cousin saw it. Well, he heard it, and my cousin hears a great deal when he's been drinking.","
","ev","str","^glassTank","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_flats","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^Somebody every day, mind you. Traders, couriers, drivers hauling fuel. The ones that worry me are the quiet ones who ask about the <term=granary>Granary</term>.","
","^Soldiers come down from Nose to buy water too. They're polite, I'll give them that.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Drivers with nothing in the back. The raiders pay them to find out how much grain we've got in store, so they know how much to ask us for.","
","^Not that they need spies. Odile writes the grain count on the Granary gate every night for anyone to read. She calls that honest. I call it saving the raiders a trip.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_granary","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Soldiers playing at being a town, if you ask me. They eat our grain and send us orders back, and they're perfectly polite whenever they want something.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Not on the open road. Nobody guards that, which is the trouble with it. But Nose won't let a truck out of its own gate without a gun on it, so don't go up there unarmed.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_roads","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^They'll let you in. Getting out's the trouble. You'll sit inside their gate till you buy a gun off them, at their price.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^Pim Arslan, who cuts lenses, says every ripple in it leans the same way, toward the <term=fallen_sun>Fallen Sun</term>. That's the crater where the ship came down.","
","^I won't stand on it at noon, whatever it points at. The <term=sunward>Sunward</term> have their own opinion, mind. They worship whatever lies in that crater, and they'll share it with anyone who stands still.","
","ev","str","^talkGlassLean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_glass","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Take them into the crater, if they'll go. Folk say a stranger who goes in with the Sunward doesn't come out. I say they do come out, green at the edges and quiet.","
","^I've never followed one in, and I won't.","
","ev","str","^talkSunwardTake","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^Once. A woman came up the canal road at dusk and asked me for water. Her hands had a green shine to them in the dark, and she drank bucket after bucket without a word.","
","^She didn't pay, and I didn't ask her to. She walked back the way she came, toward the crater.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"towed_to_bowl"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Mind your slate. I don't forget a bowl of grain. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["^ Come back when you've coin for a bucket. ",{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_rumor"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_flats"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_glass"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_sunward"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strangers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_granary"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_soldiers"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_roads"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_came_out"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_tow"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_varga"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_strip"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_farm"},false,{"VAR=":"hattie_unarmed"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_jory.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Jory Baptiste. I speak for the tenants, which is to say I talk and the <term=senate>Senate</term> nods off. Sit down, the stool's free. It's the only free thing in <term=bowl>Bowl</term>, so enjoy it.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the tenants?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^How does a tenant get a vote?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why do you send tenants into the patrol?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_patrol"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Does the patrol trouble you?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do the raiders have to do with the grain?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_filled"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do the top terraces stay green?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_green"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of Nose?","/str",{"VAR?":"jory_nose"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^We grow the food, and the citizens eat it. You can tell us apart by the dirt under the nails. We work the families' terraces and keep a share of what we grow. We've no vote in the Senate, so the families decide what we plant and what we're paid.","
","^The top terraces, where the old families live, stay green even in a dry year. Nobody's explained that to me, and I wouldn't dare ask. A miracle's a miracle.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_green","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_nose","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^He serves in the Bowl road patrol for a decade. Then the Senate lets him drop a pebble in a jar. My grandfather died one season short, which was bad timing, but he always kept his own schedule.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_patrol","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Because the Senate wrote the rule and I read it back to them slowly. They said service earns a vote, so I send them the service. They let tenants carry rifles on the road and pay half the cost on grain runs, and nobody asked what a rifle in a tenant's hands might mean on voting day.","
","^The patrol knows my face by now. I've noticed the patrol and the raiders in the south get paid out of the same sacks, but that's a longer story. I've been told I'm a long story myself.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"jory_filled","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^It does, and it knows where I live. They searched my house at night once and said they were looking for a rifle. They found a spoon, and I told them to keep it because I've got more. A man should be known by somebody.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Kiln Camp, the raiders in the south, gets a sack from the <term=granary>Granary</term> for every armed truck that crosses their road. The patrol is paid out of the tenants' share of the same grain. We pay Kiln and we pay the patrol, and we pay both with the same grain.","
","^The sack leaves the store once and the Senate counts it twice. The Senate says it all adds up, and it does, the way a bucket with a hole adds up.","
","ev","str","^talkGranaryGate","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^Because, if the word's right, the household's own tanker fills up at the Pump Station every week and drives straight up to the top gardens. Its loads go in nobody's book. If you say so in the market, they'll ask for the book, so I say it only here.","
","^Have I seen the tanker unload? No. I've seen the kitchen gardens up there, and they're very green for a dry year. Either the tanker exists or those cabbages are saints.","
","ev","str","^talkSeepPipe","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They ration everyone and call it kindness. A fed man in a line is still a man in a line. Ask me again in a famine and I might change my mind, or I might not, because I'm a stubborn fellow when I'm hungry.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_patrol"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_filled"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_green"},false,{"VAR=":"jory_nose"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

bowl_ruben.story:
{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sit a while, the shade is free. I am Ruben, and I keep the canal gates. That means I decide which fields drink first, so I'm used to being cursed by people who are only thirsty. What is on your mind?","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What is this place?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who runs Bowl?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get water, or find work?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^What did your grandmother tell you about the old days?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_old"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_sun"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What is the Fallen Sun really?","/str","str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Pump Station?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_water"},"str","^pump-station","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What are the tenants saying?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why did the Senate refuse the loan from Pierce?","/str",{"VAR?":"ruben_senate"},"/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^Bowl is a farm built in terraces down the inside of a crater. The canals here still carry water, and water runs downhill, and so do people. Folk came for the canals and stayed for the seed.","
","^My grandmother kept these same gates before me. She liked to say that a town is only a field that learned to talk.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_old","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^The canal families do. Every gate has a family that tends it, and every family has a say in the Senate, the council of citizens that decides for all of Bowl. It is a slow way to decide anything, but nobody I know has starved waiting for a quick answer.","
","^The tenants who work the terraces for the families aren't citizens, so they have no seat. In the last drought, Pierce Corporation offered the Senate a long loan of grain. Pierce insures trucks and lends money, and the Senate argued over that loan for a whole season.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_senate","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Water is Hattie's trade. She keeps the well house and sells a bucket to anyone with coin. Work is Dag's, because he rides with the <term=farmers>Farmers</term> and knows what hauls are waiting.","
","^I only open the gates. The water that goes through them belongs to the families, and the water trucks bring it from the Pump Station. That's a pumpworks out on the flat, hours away. They pour it into the canals at the bottom of Bowl, and the families share it out.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^She said the whole basin was orchards in her time, from wall to wall, and the canals ran full in every season. Then the sky fell and the fruit went with it. She never could agree with herself on which came first.","
","^What fell is what people call the Fallen Sun.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"ruben_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^People say it was a ship, bigger than all of Bowl. It came down burning and dug a crater out in the basin. Some say it brought the end of the world with it, but I say the end was already here. The ship only added one more bucket to a field that was flooded already.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^So you've stood in that crater, and you know more of it than I do. <term=nose>Nose</term> calls the ship a warship, and Hattie at the well house calls it a seed ship that lost its way. I can only tell you that nothing grows near it, and of any place that is the worst thing I know how to say.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^In the last dry year its pumps drew mud by noon, and the Senate argued over whose fault that was, as if the pumps had been listening.","
","^Wendell Ondra kept the pump book there all his life and died at his gauges. His niece Agnes keeps the book now, and she writes down every drop.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^They say they feed Bowl and have no say in it, and they're right. The families never wanted to tell a tenant what to think, only what to plant.","
","^Jory Baptiste speaks for them on the terraces. He is quick, and I like him, and I vote against him anyway.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Because Pierce wanted the canal gates as surety. If a dry year came and we couldn't pay, Pierce would own the water, and the families would be tenants on their own terraces.","
","^My grandmother would have thrown the man in the canal. The Senate only argued with him for a season, which I suppose is how we throw people now.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","end",null]}],null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_old"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_sun"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_senate"},false,{"VAR=":"ruben_water"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The truck stops dead, and your forehead meets the dash with a sound you feel in your teeth. ","#","^place: The cab","/#","
","^Something warm runs into your left eye. A thin high whine fills your ears, and under it the engine ticks as it cools. So that's what losing sounds like.","
","^Your sleeve comes away dark and wet. You blink until the cracked windshield stops sliding sideways.","
","^Out past the hood, where the dust is settling, the other truck has stopped side on. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Its gun is still pointed your way, and a thin grey thread of smoke climbs from the barrel. A figure in goggles stands braced behind it with both hands on the grips.","
","^You tell your hands to do something. They stay in your lap, heavy as sacks. So you wait for the shot, and you find you're too tired to mind much.","
","^The shot doesn't come. ","#","^page","/#","
","^When you look again, the barrel has swung up and away. The gunner pushes the goggles up, spits over the side and climbs down.","
","^They walk to your truck slow, with a rifle slung across their back, and they don't even glance at the cab as they pass. Why would they? You're not going anywhere. The bed creaks under their weight. For a while you listen to them go through everything you own, unhurried, like somebody doing chores.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"intro_step"},"str","^ambush","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["^ Then the hood creaks up, and a wrench works at something in the engine for a long while. You'd tell them to leave it, if you could talk. ",{"->":"start.38"},null]}],"nop","
","^On the way back they stop by your door. A dented canteen lands on the seat beside you, half full and sloshing. Then boots on gravel, a door slamming, and an engine pulling away across the flat until the wind covers it. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You're alive. You didn't expect that. After a long while your hands come back to you, and you get the cap off the canteen and drink, and somewhere in the middle of it you pass out.","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^stat: money Money","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The canteen has been empty since dawn. You shake it by your ear anyway, as if the water might be hiding in there. It isn't. ","#","^place: The rim","/#","
","^You have walked since the stars were out, and the sun has been burning through the cloth on your head since it came up. Walking east was stupid. Not that the west had anything better. Your shirt is stiff with salt, and your lips have split at the corners, and you try not to lick them, because that only makes it worse.","
","^The rock you have been climbing all morning ends at an edge. Below it lies a basin so wide that the far side is only a paler line in the haze. ","#","^page","/#","
","^To the north a thin line might be a road. Past it, something in the haze might be a town, or might be the heat playing tricks again. It has done that twice today.","
","^At the foot of the slope stands a water tower over a few roofs. No smoke, and nothing moves. But a tower means a well. Or it used to.","
","^You go down sideways, heels dug in, and the stones slide out from under your boots and clatter away ahead of you. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Halfway down you stop sweating. You know what that means. If you sit down now, you might not get up, so you don't sit down.","
","^Up close the tank is rusted brown and stands on thin iron legs. A gun mount is bolted to the rail at the top, with no gun in it. Somebody kept watch from up there, and then somebody stopped. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The farm","/#","
","^The house has lost its roof. The fence posts lean every which way, like drunks holding each other up. The goat pen holds dry droppings and no goats.","
","^The tap under the tower squeals when you work the handle. The pipe coughs a thread of rust onto your boots and gives nothing else. You hold the handle down a while longer anyway, as if the pipe might change its mind.","
","^A rope lies coiled beside the well, with a knot tied every arm's length.","
","^Behind the tower, what's left of a shed has folded in on itself. Something long and square sits under the fallen roof sheet. The house is closer, though, and a house might have a jar of something in a corner.","
",{"->":".^.farm"},{"farm":[["#","^checkpoint: start.farm","/#","ev","str","^Drop the rope down the well.","/str",{"VAR?":"arrival_rope"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Go into the house.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Go to the shed.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"start.rope"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.house"},null],"c-2":["
",{"->":"start.shed"},null]}],null],"rope":["ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"arrival_rope","re":true},"^You drop the end down the shaft and let it run through your hands until it goes slack. Then you haul it back up, knot by knot.","
","^Not one knot is wet. Somebody measured water with this rope, back when there was water to measure.","
",{"->":".^.^.farm"},null],"house":[["#","^checkpoint: start.house","/#","^You step through the doorway into a room with no roof. Sand has drifted into the corners. A table and a stove are left, and a cot with no blanket. Whoever lived here took everything light enough to carry. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The house","/#","
","ev","str","^Look around.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Go out to the shed.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},{"c-0":["
",{"->":"start.look"},null],"c-1":["
",{"->":"start.shed"},null]}],null],"look":["ev",50,{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^No jar of anything. The stove is cold and empty, and the table drawer holds a dead beetle. But under the cot, one floorboard sits a little higher than the rest, and when you get your fingers under it, it comes up with a squeak.","
","^In the hollow lies a tobacco tin. Inside, wrapped in a strip of oilcloth, is a fold of notes, soft from handling. Somebody hid this from somebody. Well, they're not here to argue.","
","^You put it in your shirt and go out to the shed.","
",{"->":".^.^.shed"},null],"shed":["^Under the fallen roof sheet, in the shade, sits a pickup. ","#","^page ","/#","#","^place: The farm","/#","
","^It's old and square, with a flat grille and round lamps, the kind of truck that outlives its owners. The paint has worn down to grey undercoat. The tires are soft but whole, and the bed is boxed in with welded plate.","
","^A machine gun stands on a turning mount behind the cab, its barrel wrapped in rag against the dust. A pair of steel pins lock the mount. One pin is bright and new and the other worn dull, as if somebody fixed half a problem.","
","^The hinge shrieks when you pull the door, and something small scrabbles out from under the bed. The cab smells of engine oil and old cigarettes. And the key is in the ignition. Just sitting there, with a brass tag on its ring, like somebody stepped out for a minute and meant to come right back.","
","^Behind the seat there's a tin box, and in it a food ration wrapped in greased paper. Your stomach clenches at the sight of it. You hold it a while, then put it back in the box. Eat it now and it's gone. Keep it, and it might be the difference between reaching that town and not. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You twist the key. The starter grinds, slows and quits.","
","^You twist it again. The engine catches for a breath, shakes the whole cab and dies. "Come on, you rusted pig," you tell it.","
","^You lean your forehead on the hot wheel and wait. Then you try once more, and it coughs, misses, coughs again, and holds. It runs rough and lopsided, and the mirror shakes with it. It's the best sound you have heard in your life, or at least since the stars went out this morning.","
","^You ease out of the shed. The roof sheet scrapes the length of the cab and slides off the tailgate, and the basin opens up in front of the hood. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The fuel needle sits a little under a quarter, and your tongue sticks to your teeth. The town in the haze had better be real, and it had better be close.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"arrival_rope"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Somewhere close, a bucket is coming up a well on a creaking rope. You lie still and listen to it for a while, because it is the best sound in the world. ","#","^place: Bowl","/#","
","^You're lying on a bench under a roof of woven reeds. Past the shade run canals full of slow brown water. Past them, fields climb the slope in steps, green with crops. Green. You'd forgotten the color.","
","^You sit up, and your head swims, then settles. Your pickup stands crooked at the edge of the yard with its hood propped open. A tow chain that isn't yours hangs coiled off the bumper. It has a brass tag on it, the same kind as the one on your key. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The bed is empty. Somebody went through the engine and left the bolts where they fell. Well. At least they left you the truck.","
","^A broad woman with flour on her forearms sets a cup of water on the bench beside you. Then she sits down at the other end of it. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Drink it slow. A tow man brought you in at first light and set you on my bench. He asked me one thing and drove off. No name, and no coin either. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","^She nods at the chain on your bumper.","
","^He asked after a Varga woman. There's a Ruth Varga up on the third terrace who buys her water here every morning and pays in sorghum. Whether she's his Varga, he didn't stay to find out. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","^Whatever they pulled out of your engine, the yard by the gate sells new, if you have the coin. You look like someone who eats first and pays later, so I'll put the grain on your slate. ","#","^speaker: Hattie","/#","
","^The water is cold and tastes of stone, and you drink it slow, because she's watching. A bowl of hot grain comes after it. ","#","^page","/#","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: ledger_read
facts.text: Ledger: cans went missing on the third, seventh and eleventh nights. Pell was on duty each time.

facts.name: gate_checked
facts.text: Gate log: Corporal Vance signed out late on the third, seventh and eleventh nights, alone, with an empty truck bed.

facts.name: saw_swap
facts.text: Fuel shed: Vance asked Pell to swap shifts tonight. Pell agreed without looking up. Vance has a scar across his chin.

facts.name: knows_scar
facts.text: Sabine: a corporal brings her the cans. Big hands, a scar across the chin. Never a name.

facts.name: found_seals
facts.text: Barracks: a tin of Army fuel seals under Vance's cot, cut clean.

facts.name: saw_handoff
facts.text: Back fence: at dawn Vance passed cans over the wire to a truck with Sabine's mark.

","^Him. He sold us our own radio back, and I paid stock price for it. That set came off wagon Seven. She ran water drums from the Pump Station down to Bowl every week, and she went dark on the bend in the Bowl north road. The crew walked in and reported raiders, and her cannon lost over the edge. Command wrote her off. I log it.","
","^The scavenger said for a little more that the cannon's still on her. I didn't pay a little more.","
","ev","str","^wagonNose","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Written off by order, so whatever's left on her is yours. Don't make a habit of picking over Army property.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You've got something in your hand you keep turning over. Don't show it to me. Show it to Lena at the bench. I log what I see there.","

","^Teller drives the water cart now. His stripes are in my drawer. A pair of depot trucks with the same one-pin mount are off the road until Lena has looked at them. Command hasn't answered. I log that too.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^The raid report and the stub share a page, and command reads the top of it. A pair of depot trucks with the same one-pin mount are off the road until Lena has looked at them. That's as far as my sheet goes.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Corporal Teller came back from the wash pit with wet hands and a light wallet. I don't log what I don't see, and I didn't see anything.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^Soldiers buy water at Bowl, and Bowl talks over the cups. Now my men come back up the road asking whether their own pins will hold. You told Bowl before you told my log. I won't forget the order you did it in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","^A piece of Army steel from wagon Seven changed hands at the <term=salvage_yard>Yard</term>. I logged the sale. Your name is on the line, beside the price.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","^Old Orchard, the Old Army's depot. The machine tools are the Guild's, and command rents them. Who pays that rent is above my sheet.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_workshop","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-13":["
","^No gun, no gate pass. The line hands every driver a steel mount with his pass, so nobody can tell me he had nothing to bolt on. What happens to the mount after that is between the driver and <term=pierce>Pierce</term>. Pierce writes his paper. I don't ask.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_gate_law","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-14":["
","^Tamsin Roe, of the Guild. The Guild carries the mail between the towns. She drives with no gun of her own. The courier who runs with her carries the rifle. A pair gets through my gate, but I don't like what it teaches the other drivers. Brave or stupid, I haven't decided.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_courier","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-15":["
","^It's the insurance that pays a driver when his truck is shot. Pierce won't write it for a mount with one pin. Command ordered one pin. What a driver does about that, I don't log.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_paper","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-16":["

",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^What do you do here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^Any advice for my truck?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where do I find cheap parts?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Where can I get clean water?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Why look at the pins?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_swivel"},{"VAR?":"asked_pins"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^Do you trust Brann's mounts?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_brann"},{"VAR?":"asked_brann"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Kiln riders?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you know about the Fallen Sun?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_sun"},"str","^fallen-sun","/str",{"x()":"found","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_sun"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Is there anything for the glare?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_glare"},{"VAR?":"asked_glare"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^I brought something from wagon Seven.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^I keep the Army's trucks running. Anybody else's too, if they bring them to my bench. Engines, plate, mounts, whatever breaks. I can tell what's wrong with a truck by the sound of it pulling in.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^Every part does one job and fails at another. Heavy plate stops rounds, but it eats your speed. A big gun eats your deck on top of that. So buy what the road needs, not what shines on the shelf. And if you've got a gun on a swivel, look at the pins first. The swivel's the ring that swings the gun across your bed.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_swivel","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^The Salvage Yard, a way south of here. The crews strip whatever gets towed in, so parts go for next to nothing. You'll have to put up with the smell of burnt oil. For real plate you want the Fallen Sun, the big hull in the crater. I say that through my teeth.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_sun","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^Green Pit, out past the road. It's a pump outpost round an old cistern, and they pull the water up from deep rock and sell it by the can. It's clean, and it isn't cheap. Bring coin.","
","ev","str","^greenPit","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^Because the copy they bolt on at the gate has one. I've seen what one does on a hard bend. The mount slides and the gun swings round into your own cab. Otto Brann made the first swivel. He gave his a second pin. He was right, and I told command so. Nobody asks a mechanic.","
","ev","str","^talkOnePin","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pins","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_brann","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^The ones with his mark, yes. He signs every weld. A weld you can read is a weld you can trust. I've even seen <term=kiln>Kiln</term> riders running captured ones on their own trucks. Good steel doesn't care who owns it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_brann","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^They're raiders from the camp in the south, and I'd sooner not fix a truck they've stripped. But the old woman who keeps their furnace, Dagny Brask, melts captured guns into tools. I own a few. They're decent. Don't tell command I said so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^Best metal I ever put a torch to, and the worst place to fetch it. The brass call that hull a warship. I'd like them to show me one gun mount on it. There isn't one. It's cargo holds, all of it. And the glare off the glass around it will blind you by noon.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_sun","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^Lenses cut from the fused glass, dark as smoke. I wear an old pair on bad days. I don't know who sells them now.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_glare","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["

","^The <term=pump_station>Pump Station</term> is a pumphouse behind a wall of oil drums. It smells of hot iron and wet stone. Water trucks wait in a line at the loading bay.","
","^Every hose at the bay has a meter box on it, except one. A big grey tanker with a lantern painted on its door is filling from that one. It sits low on its springs already.","
","^A woman in a canvas apron stands at a row of dials and copies each number into a book.","
","^A man in a grey coat sits on a drum by the gate with a mug of tea. He watches the woman, not you.","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_book","re":true},"^The big dial counts every barrel the pump brings up. Once a week Agnes writes its number down and sets it back to nothing, so the number is the week's whole total.","
","^You read her this week's number. She writes it in the book and your name beside it, then holds the book up so you can see the page. You've never had your name in a pump book before.","
","^Barrels a week; Pumped up, by the big dial; Bowl's trucks, by the hose meters; Passing trucks, by the hose meters; Household tanker, by its meter ","#","^head","/#","
","^Last spring; 410; 380; 10; 20 ","#","^row","/#","

","^This week; 300; 220; 10; meter taken off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Every hose has a meter, and every truck that fills goes in by name. Your tank is in the passing column, under your name. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^The pump brings up less every season, and Bowl's trucks get less too. Until autumn the tanker's hose had a meter, and the columns added up to the barrel. Since the meter came off, the gap grows every week. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"knows_pipe","re":true},"^The <term=senate>Senate</term> ordered it. That tanker belongs to the Archon's household. The Archon heads the Senate, and his household lives on the top terrace of <term=bowl>Bowl</term>. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","
","^Now the tanker loads and goes, and I'm not allowed to write it down. Whatever the gap is, that's what it takes. ","#","^speaker: Agnes","/#","

facts.name: book_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy: the pump brings up less every season, and the household's tanker takes more. Her guess, if that goes on: Bowl's trucks get almost nothing by next autumn.

facts.name: margin_read
facts.text: Agnes's copy, last page: for Mirela, to compare with hers.

facts.name: offer_heard
facts.text: Steward Aurel Brede offered money to lose the copy and forget the dial.

facts.name: reserve_known
facts.text: Steward: half of the tanker's water fills a tank under the top terrace. It is the Senate's reserve for a dry year, and only the Archon may open it.

facts.name: valve_read
facts.text: Top terrace: the household's tanker unloads into a stone tank. Its inlet has an empty flange where a meter used to sit.

facts.name: canal_matches
facts.text: Every barrel Agnes loaded onto Bowl's trucks reached Mirela's trough. The dial is the other half, and you read it.

","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Lena holds the stub up to the light, and her face goes still.","
","^Bright, flat, no rust, no saw marks. Nobody cut that. It broke in one go, with the gun pulling on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Ilan. Come and look at this. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over. He takes a half pin from his shirt pocket and sets it face-down on yours. The broken faces meet with no gap between them.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the gunner on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The pin went on the bend, and the gun came round into the cab. That's how my arm went. I picked my half off the cab floor. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^Lena looks it over once and puts it down.","
","^Somebody beat the face off this. I can't read a break that isn't there. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^The soldier comes over and takes a half pin from his shirt pocket. He holds it beside yours. Its face is bright. Yours is a grey smear, and they don't meet.","
","^Private Ilan Duvall. He was the gunner on wagon Seven. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":"bench.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.report"},{"report":["#","^checkpoint: bench.report","/#","^I fitted that swivel by order, with one pin. I wrote to command that it would kill somebody, and they filed it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^Sergeant Kovac at dispatch logs every Army truck out and in. Here's his page for wagon Seven. I keep a copy, because my name's on the swivel. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^She pulls a creased sheet from under a tin of bolts and flattens it with her rag.","
","^Seven ; out ; cannon on swivel, one pin ","#","^head","/#","
","^Report ; Cpl Teller ; raiders at the bend, cannon torn off the wagon and lost over the edge ","#","^row","/#","
","^Margin ; Pvt Duvall ; pin sheared ","#","^row","/#","
","^Command ; by order ; wagon written off ","#","^row","/#","
","^Lost over the edge, it says. You took this stub out of the ring with the cannon still sitting on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
","^It's the first thing you've heard her say slowly.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Ilan's half on its own is a bit of steel in a private's pocket. It could be off any truck. Yours came out of the ring on wagon Seven. Together they say this is the pin from wagon Seven, and your half stayed in the ring with the gun on it. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.46"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"halves_fit"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Give it to Kovac. Fixing the report is command's business, and command may never look. But a pin that snapped on the road is enough for Kovac to keep every truck with that mount in the yard. That much is his to do. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^With a clean face, I'd send you straight to Kovac. This one, he'd log as scrap, unless somebody saw the face before it was beaten. ","#","^speaker: Lena","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.53"},null]}],"nop","
","^You roll the stub under your thumb on the bench. An hour with a punch in a hot hollow, and it comes down to who gets to hold it.","

","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"offer_heard","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"report_seen","re":true},"^The yard is hot and smells of the wash pit. Teller stands where the shed wall hides him from the bench. ","#","^page","/#","
","^Look. I wrote that the cannon went over the edge. A wagon with no gun isn't worth a tow, so command wrote her off, and nobody drove out to look at the ring. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Command's order says one pin holds if you take the bends slow. So if the pin goes on a bend, the driver took it fast. I was driving. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^In Nose a corporal's family eats on his card. My sister draws her bread on my stripes. Lose them, and her card goes back to the clerk, and she's got a boy of her own. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Ilan says the pin broke. Lena says the pin broke. Kovac can't pull trucks off the road on a private's word or a mechanic's letter. A broken part out of the ring, he has to log as a fault. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^I'll pay you for it. It goes down the sump, and you never saw the hollow. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","

","^Teller tied the gun down so it wouldn't swing again, and we walked. He wrote raiders at the desk. I told Kovac it was the pin, and he put me in the margin. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","

","^Teller is still waiting by the door for his word outside. You give it to him here instead. ","#","^page","/#","
","^You put it to him in front of Lena, with the stub between you on the bench: his report says the cannon went over the edge, and you took this out of the ring with the cannon still sitting on it.","
","^Then I was wrong about the edge. It was dusty, and they were shooting. It was raiders. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.5"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You don't argue.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Then you ask him what the raiders shot with. You walked that hollow and found no casing in the grit and no bullet hole in the wagon.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.7"},null]}],"nop","
","^You don't look at Teller. You look at Duvall, and so does Teller. The boy rubs the strap of his sling. When he speaks, he uses Teller's first name.","
","^Bram. You pulled me out of that cab. You were there when it came round. Say it. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
","^Teller takes his hand off his watch. It's the soldier who breaks him, not you, and you're glad of it.","
","^The pin went on the bend, and the gun came round into the cab. I took the bend fast. I said raiders to keep my stripes. They pay my sister's ration card. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Teller says it again in front of him and signs it. Kovac writes it under the raid report and crosses nothing out.","
","^Corporal. Water cart, from tomorrow. Leave the stripes on my desk. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^And my sister's bread? ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^A water carter's card feeds one man. Rations aren't mine to give. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","^Kovac holds out his hand for the stub. It's what you carried it up here for, and you give it to him. He counts out the finder's rate for it, ","ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},"out","/ev","^ M. Then he draws a line through a pair of depot trucks with the same swivel, off the road until Lena has looked at them.","
","ev","str","^admitted","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"fee"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^If you drive down to Bowl, my mother buys her water at Hattie's well house. Tell her my arm's set. ","#","^speaker: Duvall","/#","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You lean on it and tell him he lied in his report, that raiders don't leave a cannon behind. It comes out too fast and too loud, an accusation instead of a question. He hears that, and he steadies.","
","^I said it at the desk and I say it now. And this one was down in the hollow picking over Army property. Ask what else is in that truck. ","#","^speaker: Teller","/#","
","^Lena sends Duvall for Sergeant Kovac. Kovac comes and logs the stub as found, with your name as the finder and Teller's word beside it, and leaves the report standing above both.","
","^You'd have had a finder's rate for that. The Corporal says you stripped her, and that's one word against another. I don't pay out on those. ","#","^speaker: Kovac","/#","
","ev","str","^logged","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^He still draws a line through a pair of depot trucks with the same swivel. Teller goes out. Lena wipes her hands on her rag and looks at neither you nor Teller. You can't tell which of you she's angrier with.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.12"},null]}],"nop","
","end",null],"sold":["ev",{"VAR?":"price"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev","str","^buried","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"^You go back out to the yard. Teller counts the money into your hand, note by note, and holds out his other hand for the stub. ","#","^page","/#","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^bent","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^He doesn't look at its face. He doesn't know what he's looking for.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.25"},null]}],"nop","
","^He walks it to the wash pit and drops it through the grate. You hear it hit water.","
","^When you go back past the shed, Lena is writing on a scrap of sign-out sheet and doesn't look up. Duvall is turning his half of the pin over in his fingers. Kovac's page still says the cannon went over the edge, and the trucks with the same mount still go out in the morning.","
","end",null]}],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"halves_fit"},false,{"VAR=":"report_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"offer_heard"},false,{"VAR=":"heard_duvall"},60,{"VAR=":"price"},20,{"VAR=":"fee"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

facts.name: halves_fit
facts.text: Bench: Duvall's half of the pin and yours meet face to face, with no gap.

facts.name: report_seen
facts.text: Dispatch log: Corporal Teller's report says raiders ran wagon Seven down at the bend and the cannon went over the edge. Command wrote the wagon off.

facts.name: heard_duvall

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["#","^view: page","/#","#","^fact: wagon_saw Hollow: no shell casing in the grit and no bullet hole in the wagon. The dents in the cab push inward from the bed side.","/#","#","^fact: followed Ridge: the newer tracks go up to the bend, where a truck stood and turned round. No saw marks, no rust, no lead smeared on it.","/#","#","^fact: wagon_watched Ridge: somebody up there watched you work and was gone when you looked.","/#","
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^The wagon lies nose-down at the bottom of the hollow, below the bend in the Bowl north road. It left the road on the bend and ran all the way down the slope. Army green under the dust. The stencil on the door is the Nose Army's, from the town on the mountain to the north-east. ","#","^place: A hollow off the Bowl north road","/#","
","^You've been through everything that opens. The radio is gone from the cab, and its bracket hangs empty. The bed is bare: wooden chocks for a row of water drums, and no drums.","
","^The cannon is still on its swivel ring, but it has swung right round. Its back end lies across the cab roof, and the back wall of the cab is caved in.","
","^A tow chain is wrapped round the gun where it lies and hooked to the cab frame, so somebody tied it down after it swung. The chain has been cut since. The cut ends are still bright.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Walk the hollow. ","#","^check: perception 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"walked"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":5},"ev","str","^Follow the newer tracks up the slope.","/str",{"VAR?":"walked"},{"VAR?":"followed"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":5},"ev","str","^Look at the gun mount. ","#","^check: machining 1","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"mount_seen"},"!","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":5},"ev","str","^Spend an hour tapping the stub out. ","#","^check: machining 2","/#","/str",{"VAR?":"mount_seen"},{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":5},"ev","str","^Leave the hollow.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"walked","re":true},"^Wide tire tracks with chain marks come down the slope to the wagon's bed and go back up. Rain has softened them. The drums are gone, and you'd bet on that truck, though tracks don't say what it carried.","
","^The tracks of a pair of men climb out side by side to the north-east, as old as the tire tracks. After the rain somebody else came down alone, stood by the cab a while and went back up the way he came.","
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You walk a slow circle and then a wider one. There's no brass in the grit. Not one casing.","
","^You go over the wagon's sides with your hand. Road dents, rust, a scraped fender. There isn't a bullet hole in her. Raiders shoot. If they shot here, they picked up every casing after and missed the whole wagon.","
","^The dents in the cab push inward, from the bed side toward the seats.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_saw","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^You crouch over the tracks longer than they're worth. When you stand up, something moves on the ridge above the bend. You look, and it's gone. Somebody up there may have watched you work.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_watched","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.14"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"followed","re":true},"^The lone tracks climb straight to the bend, where the road runs past above the hollow. A truck stood there and turned round. Its tread matches the wagon's own tires. You'd guess an Army truck, though plenty of trucks run on Army tires.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_watched"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^Further along the ridge you find small bare footprints, a child's, running off to the east, the way the Salvage Yard lies. So that was your watcher.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.11"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"mount_seen","re":true},"^A steel pin through the ring locks a gun so it can't swing on a bend. Most drivers have a second hole drilled and a second pin fitted, so the gun stays put if one pin goes. This ring has one hole.","
","^The pin has snapped. Its stub still sits in the hole.","
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You thumb the stub's broken face. It's bright and flat. No saw marks, no rust, no lead smeared on it. You've seen pins snap like that, all at once, when a heavy load wrenches them.","
","^There's a dent in the back of the cab the shape of the gun's back end, at the height of a man sitting down. Whoever sat there took that blow.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_read","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.14"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^It's a broken pin. It looks like any other broken pin to you. Somebody who fits these mounts for a living could tell you more.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.14"},null]}],"nop","
","^The stub is the one piece of this wagon you could carry up to Nose and put on a desk. It's wedged tight. Getting it out would take a punch and most of an hour, and a slip would ruin the broken face.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","ev",{"x()":"passed"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You set the punch square on the stub and tap, and tap again, and don't hurry. Sweat runs into your eyes. Then the stub drops out of the bottom of the hole into your palm.","
","^Its broken face is still bright, without a new mark on it.","
","ev","str","^held","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^The punch slips on the third blow, and the hammer comes down on the broken face. You swear at it. The stub comes out in the end, bent, and its face is a grey smear.","
","ev","str","^bent","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^.6"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev","str","^wagonPin","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
",{"->":".^.^.^.9"},null]}],"nop","
",{"->":"leave"},null]}],null]}],"leave":["#","^checkpoint: leave","/#","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_saw"},{"VAR?":"wagon_read"},"&&","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^If anybody asked, you'd tell it like this: the pin snapped on the bend, the gun swung into the cab, and the crew tied it down and walked out. You can't prove the last part. You can prove that a pin snapped.","
",{"->":"leave.9"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"/ev",["du","ev","str","^held","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The stub goes in your shirt pocket with its face clean.","
",{"->":"leave.17"},null]}],["du","ev","str","^bent","/str","==","/ev",{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["pop","
","^The bent stub goes in your pocket. Its face is a smear now. All it shows is that a pin broke.","
",{"->":"leave.17"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["pop","
","^You leave the stub in the ring and the gun on the roof.","
",{"->":"leave.17"},null]}],"nop","
","^The Nose Army owns this wagon, and somebody up there wrote down what happened to it. Whether that matches what's in this hollow is the question.","
","^Your own water is warm by now. You drink it anyway.","
","end",null],"global decl":["ev","str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"depot_thief"},false,{"VAR=":"first_knockout_seen"},"str","^off","/str",{"VAR=":"intro_step"},false,{"VAR=":"towed_to_bowl"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"ambush_raider"},false,{"VAR=":"varga_truck_known"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"pipe_fate"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"marr_regard"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_seen"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_saw"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_read"},false,{"VAR=":"wagon_watched"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate"},false,{"VAR=":"walked"},false,{"VAR=":"followed"},false,{"VAR=":"mount_seen"},"/ev","end",null]}],"listDefs":{}}

{"inkVersion":21,"root":[["
",["done",{"#n":"g-0"}],null],"done",{"pin_price":["ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^held","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","ev",30,"/ev","~ret",{"->":".^.^.^.8"},null]}],"nop","
","ev",15,"/ev","~ret",null],"start":["#","^checkpoint: start","/#","^Sefa Krol. I trade for the families off the Burnt Convoy. Show me what you carry and I'll tell you what it's worth. Keep your hand off my table.","
",{"->":".^.hub"},{"hub":[["#","^checkpoint: start.hub","/#","ev","str","^Who are the families of the Burnt Convoy?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-0","flg":4},"ev","str","^What do you sell here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-1","flg":4},"ev","str","^What is the road like out here?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-2","flg":4},"ev","str","^Who runs this yard?","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-3","flg":4},"ev","str","^Is the Burnt Convoy picked clean?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_picked"},"str","^burntConvoy","/str",{"x()":"has_note","exArgs":1},"||",{"VAR?":"asked_picked"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-4","flg":5},"ev","str","^What was the book you sold the Yard?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_book"},{"VAR?":"asked_book"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-5","flg":5},"ev","str","^What else do you hear about Pierce?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_pguns"},{"VAR?":"asked_pguns"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-6","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do you never take the last water?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_water"},{"VAR?":"asked_water"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-7","flg":5},"ev","str","^Why do the Kiln riders leave you alone?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_kiln"},{"VAR?":"asked_kiln"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-8","flg":5},"ev","str","^Has a rider ever come to you with nothing?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_rider"},{"VAR?":"asked_rider"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-9","flg":5},"ev","str","^What do you make of the Army post?","/str",{"VAR?":"heard_post"},{"VAR?":"asked_post"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-10","flg":5},"ev","str","^I've got the pin from wagon Seven's ring.","/str",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^none","/str","!=",{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&",{"VAR?":"sefa_priced"},"!","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-11","flg":5},"ev","str","^Sell her the stub and the place.","/str",{"VAR?":"sefa_priced"},{"VAR?":"wagon_fate"},"str","^none","/str","==","&&","/ev",{"*":".^.c-12","flg":5},"ev","str","^Goodbye.","/str","/ev",{"*":".^.c-13","flg":4},{"c-0":["
","^People who lived in the burnt trucks on the road. The road crews cleared the wrecks a while ago, so we moved here, to the north side of the Yard. We're not a camp. A camp has a flag and a man who wants to be called sir. We're first to any wreck and last to leave it. That's all we are. Men on the air say there's nothing left out there to pick. They're welcome to think so.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_picked","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-1":["
","^What the road is done with. Wiring, wheel rims, a gun with its pin broken. Anything with a second life in it, if you're not too proud to give it one. I buy too, so put what you carry on the table. Keep your hand off it. Years ago we sold the <term=salvage_yard>Yard</term> a book we took off a <term=pierce>Pierce</term> truck, and people still ask me about it.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_book","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-2":["
","^Dry. Every driver sits with his water between his feet. I make a point of never taking the last of it from anyone, and you can ask me why. The Kiln riders from the camp in the south mostly leave us alone. You can ask me about that too.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_water","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_kiln","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-3":["
","^The repair crews, since they stopped answering to Pierce. The Administrator keeps them in line. Nose put an Army post inside the gate afterward. We keep to the north side of the yard, where soldiers don't like the wind.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_post","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-4":["
","^No. We pick that road every week and the road leaves more. Rust grows new things. Old Ibo, the radio man at Nose, says otherwise on the air, to men who wouldn't drive out there for a gift. Good. Let him.","
","ev","str","^talkConvoyNotClean","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_picked","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-5":["
","^A debtor book. We stopped a Pierce office truck on the road and took it off the seat. Pierce lends to the towns and insures the trucks, so that's a big name to cross. It was page after page of names and sums. I can't read the sums. The zeroes go on too long. The Yard could read them, so I sold it to them. What it says isn't for sale, and what the Yard does with it isn't my business. The crane office has a shut door now. A shut door is a loud thing.","
","ev","str","^talkCraneBook","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_book","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_pguns","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-6":["
","^That Pierce sold the <term=old_army>Old Army</term>'s guns north to <term=scrapjaw>Scrapjaw</term>, then made every driver buy a gun to get paper. I hear it from a pair of drivers who each swear the other one lied. It's good business, if it's true. A man who sells the fire and the bucket never starves.","
","ev","str","^talkPierceGuns","/str",{"x()":"note","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_pguns","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-7":["
","^A man with no water is a body, and a body is trouble. Leave him his water and he's a fool who walks on. Fools talk less than bodies. Also, my mother would find out. She finds out everything.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_water","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-8":["
","^We have a deal. Kiln has a man named Kaplan who knows a fair split. What the riders leave on the road is ours. What we find of their dead, we bury with their boots on. Nobody on either side likes it, which is how you know it works. Anyone who comes to our tables with nothing gets beans and no questions. That goes for a rider as much as a driver.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_kiln","re":true},"ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"heard_rider","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-9":["
","^Once. His brother died in the road. He ate our beans for a long time and said little, and then he went south. I won't say his name. It would be rude to the beans.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_rider","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-10":["
","^I don't trust it. The soldier at the gate writes down who comes and goes through the gate, and she writes it twice. A soldier who writes twice is afraid of something.","
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"asked_post","re":true},{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-11":["
","ev",true,"/ev",{"VAR=":"sefa_priced","re":true},"ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_watched"},"/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^I know. My children watched you crawl round my hollow all afternoon. You found my cut chain, I expect. My men found that ring was bent and went home for a torch.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],[{"->":".^.b"},{"b":["
","^That hollow is ours. My children found her ruts the week she went quiet. My men cut the chain on that cannon and found the gun too heavy to lift by hand, and they went home for a torch.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.10"},null]}],"nop","
","^A broken Nose pin is worth more than a whole one. The Yard bores second pins into Nose mounts for a fee, and a pin that sheared on an Army wagon sells a great many second pins. That's all we are.","
","ev",{"VAR?":"wagon_pin"},"str","^bent","/str","==","/ev",[{"->":".^.b","c":true},{"b":["
","^You beat the face off it, so I'm paying for the place more than the steel.","
",{"->":".^.^.^.22"},null]}],"nop","
","^She names a price for the stub and your word on where it lies: ","ev",{"f()":"pin_price"},"out","/ev","^ M. A good deal is one nobody likes.","
",{"->":".^.^.^"},null],"c-12":["
","ev","str","^sold","/str","/ev",{"VAR=":"wagon_fate","re":true},"ev",{"f()":"pin_price"},{"x()":"give_money","exArgs":1},"pop","/ev","
","^She counts the money onto the table and sweeps the stub off it into her apron, all in one move. ","#","^page","/#","
","^The Yard's crane men will hang that stub on a wire by the boring bench. Every Nose driver who stops for a second pin will see it. After the frost my men take the torch to whatever's left on her.","
